Given useSettings().timeZone is Asia/Kolkata (UTC+05:30) and the latest Completed appointment started at 20:00 UTC on 9 March

findings.text: S-1 AC5 and S-2 AC3 set useSettings().timeZone to Asia/Kolkata, the default. The likeliest wrong implementation, a hard-coded Asia/Kolkata, passes both, though REQ-9 and A-01 forbid hard-coding the zone.
